تعتبرون (form VIII)
# تَعْتَبِرُونَ (taʕtabirūna) /taʕ.ta.bi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
# تُعْتَبَرُونَ (tuʕtabarūna) /tuʕ.ta.ba.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
